title: Hallman — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Hallman.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Retro Pro Style." Specialty tier. Hallman makes retro-styled pro ranges in bold colors with modern cooking technology. Italian-inspired design with convection ovens and sealed burners.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Retro kitchen builds wanting pro-style cooking. Color range buyers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Hallman:

• Bold retro colors with pro-style cooking

• Italian-inspired design

• Convection oven standard

• Multiple color options

• Unique retro-pro crossover
